question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Two of the fugitives managed to remain free by adeptly avoiding the____________ of the police.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"pursuit"** means the action of following or chasing someone or something. (पीछा करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The police were in hot pursuit of the escaped prisoner.
 
 
 
• **"Pursuit" **refers to the act of trying to catch or attain something or someone. (पीछा करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The detective's relentless pursuit led to the capture of the criminal.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the fugitives managed to avoid the pursuit of the police.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Following** (अनुसरण करना): To come after in time or order.

 
 
• **Example:** The following day, they continued their journey.
 
 
 
• **Repression** (दमन): The action of subduing someone or something by force.
 
 
• **Example: **There was a lot of repression during the political regime.
 
 
 
• **Discovery** (खोज): The action or process of finding or being found.
 
 
• **Example:** The discovery of a new species excited the scientists.
